decisions.subject: Layer 2 stored as one row per lot with positional arrays (option 4)
decisions.recommendation: One table keyed parcel_id; arrays in scope-seed order; a SQL view names each position; losers and candidates recomputed on read; closed dictionaries for unit ids and reason codes; supersedes R-JA form C for storage.
